title: LOOP Curated Music Product Roadmap

status_definitions.in-source: Implementation is present in source; full production/end-to-end verification is not implied.
status_definitions.partial: A foundation exists; remaining user flows or edge cases need implementation.
status_definitions.planned: Retained as a good fit for LOOP but not yet claimed as implemented.
status_definitions.provider-dependent: Requires a reliable third-party data source/provider.

features.title: Rotating editorial hero banners
features.note: Cycle through a small set of real, available music features; never use placeholder tracks.

features.title: Live featured song banner from YouTube
features.note: The current Home page already fetches YouTube music-video metadata for a featured banner; verify live provider behaviour after deployment.

features.title: Artist spotlight banner
features.note: Feature an artist with MusicBrainz or trusted catalogue metadata.

features.title: New-release spotlight
features.note: Requires a reliable release feed and region-aware availability.

features.title: Mood-based hero artwork
features.note: Use available track or release artwork for mood discovery.

features.title: Subtle animated visual backgrounds
features.note: Keep motion restrained and respect reduced-motion preferences.

features.title: Recently played home shortcut
features.note: Recently played content already appears on Home; refine its placement and empty state.

features.title: Featured playlist carousel
features.note: Show real LOOP playlists and editorial collections.

features.title: Personalised banner rotation
features.note: Use a listener’s genres, saved artists and recent activity with privacy controls.

features.title: Unified search across LOOP, Apple Music, YouTube and MusicBrainz
features.note: The current Search page already calls the LOOP catalogue and external music metadata/search adapters; verify provider configuration.

features.title: Search suggestions while typing
features.note: Suggest real tracks, artists, albums and genres.

features.title: Search history
features.note: Store per-account and clearable history; respect incognito mode.

features.title: Trending search terms
features.note: Use aggregated, privacy-safe search counts rather than fabricated trends.

features.title: Search by genre and subgenre
features.note: Genre discovery shortcuts exist; richer search filters remain to be completed.

features.title: Search by language
features.note: Only display language tags when supplied by a reliable catalogue source.

features.title: Search by country or region
features.note: Apple storefront searches already use regional catalogues; add explicit region filtering.

features.title: Search by decade
features.note: Use verified release-year metadata.

features.title: Advanced filters for artist, album, genre and duration
features.note: Filters should work across the data source that actually supplies each field.

features.title: Daily personalised mix
features.note: A daily recommendation endpoint and Home shelf already exist; verify with a real signed-in account.

features.title: Weekly discovery mix
features.note: A fresh weekly mix based on opted-in listening signals.

features.title: Similar-song recommendations
features.note: Use available audio features and metadata; explain when a match is approximate.

features.title: Similar-artist recommendations
features.note: Use verified artist relationships or catalogue similarity.

features.title: Mood-aware recommendations
features.note: Mood selection and free-text mood recommendations already exist.

features.title: Activity-based suggestions
features.note: Examples include focus, workouts and relaxing; do not infer sensitive traits.

features.title: Time-aware suggestions
features.note: Use local time only as a lightweight optional signal.

features.title: Familiarity versus discovery control
features.note: Let listeners choose between familiar tracks and new discoveries.

features.title: Explain why a track was recommended
features.note: Recommendation reason fields exist in the UI; make reasons consistent and evidence-based.

features.title: Learn from likes, saves and skips
features.note: Use explicit feedback with privacy controls; avoid over-personalising from sparse signals.

features.title: Official YouTube embedded playback
features.note: The player recognises YouTube embed playback; embedding and regional restrictions still apply.

features.title: Persistent mini-player
features.note: A persistent player bar is already present in the application layout.

features.title: Expanded now-playing screen
features.note: Provide album art, track information, queue and supported playback controls.

features.title: Play queue management
features.note: The player already has a queue panel and track navigation.

features.title: Play next and add to queue
features.note: Queue foundations exist; make both actions explicit and test queue ordering.

features.title: Sleep timer
features.note: Sleep timer controls and fade handling already exist for supported local playback.

features.title: Keyboard media shortcuts
features.note: Shortcuts must avoid hijacking typing in forms and text boxes.

features.title: Playback error and unavailable-track recovery
features.note: Show clear reasons and safe alternatives; never fake audio or extract streams.

features.title: Create, edit and delete playlists
features.note: Basic playlist management already exists.

features.title: Public and private playlist settings
features.note: Make visibility explicit and enforce permissions server-side.

features.title: Playlist covers from available artwork
features.note: Use artwork the provider allows LOOP to display; retain attribution where required.

features.title: Playlist sorting and filtering
features.note: Sort by title, artist, date added and duration when data is available.

features.title: Duplicate-track detection
features.note: Duplicate/playlist-health logic exists in the source; verify that listener-facing cleanup is safe.

features.title: Playlist import and export
features.note: Support transparent metadata-only import/export; do not copy protected audio.

features.title: Smart playlists based on listener rules
features.note: Examples: liked tracks, recently added, genre or mood.

features.title: Shareable playlist links
features.note: Respect public/private settings and account ownership.

features.title: Artist profile pages
features.note: Show available biography, artwork, genres and verified links.

features.title: Album and EP pages
features.note: Display release metadata and tracklists where available.

features.title: Release-date timelines
features.note: Do not infer missing dates.

features.title: Artist discography
features.note: Use MusicBrainz or another trusted release catalogue.

features.title: Related artists
features.note: Show source-backed relationships or clearly label similarity recommendations.

features.title: Album tracklists
features.note: Use release metadata and identify incomplete tracklists.

features.title: Cover Art Archive artwork lookup
features.note: Cover Art Archive integration is present; a MusicBrainz release ID and available image are required.

features.title: MusicBrainz release and recording metadata
features.note: MusicBrainz provider integration is present; coverage varies by recording.

features.title: Artist country and genre tags
features.note: Display only sourced metadata and allow unknown values.

features.title: Official artist links
features.note: Use verified artist/provider links rather than guessed URLs.

features.title: Global top tracks
features.note: Requires a defined chart source and attribution.

features.title: Country-specific charts
features.note: Requires a chart source with country-level data.

features.title: Genre charts
features.note: Use sourced chart data or clearly labelled LOOP listening aggregates.

features.title: Language charts
features.note: Requires reliable language tags and a transparent chart methodology.

features.title: Rising artists
features.note: Define the growth metric and data window; do not invent popularity.

features.title: Trending music videos
features.note: YouTube search can supply current video results; label them as YouTube results, not universal music charts.

features.title: New releases by region
features.note: Requires reliable release dates and regional availability data.

features.title: Decade and era collections
features.note: Use verified release years; present as curated collections rather than live rankings.

features.title: Follow artists
features.note: Useful for saving artist interests and optionally receiving new-release alerts.

features.title: Share tracks and playlists
features.note: Share metadata and permitted provider links, not copied audio.

features.title: Community-curated playlists
features.note: Add reporting and moderation before public publishing.

features.title: Report and moderation tools
features.note: Artist and catalogue review workflows already form a moderation foundation.

features.title: Custom profile avatar
features.note: Allow a safe upload or selected preset with moderation and size limits.

features.title: Display name and short bio
features.note: Basic account identity exists; verify editing and privacy controls.

features.title: Favourite genres
features.note: Use onboarding/preferences already available and make them editable.

features.title: Favourite artists
features.note: Use explicit follows/saves rather than inferred sensitive interests.

features.title: Preferred music languages
features.note: An optional discovery preference.

features.title: Country and storefront preference
features.note: Regional storefront support exists; expose a clear user preference.

features.title: Listening privacy controls
features.note: Privacy settings are part of the existing account/product foundation.

features.title: Incognito listening mode
features.note: Incognito/private listening support exists in the current application.

features.title: Profile theme selection
features.note: Keep a small accessible set of themes and preserve contrast.

features.title: Song credits
features.note: Show credits only when a reliable source supplies them.

features.title: Songwriter and producer details
features.note: Use sourced recording/release credits.

features.title: ISRC display
features.note: Show the identifier when MusicBrainz or another source provides it.

features.title: Release, label and catalogue information
features.note: Display source-backed metadata.

features.title: Explicit-content labels
features.note: Only show labels supplied by a trusted provider.

features.title: Track duration and version details
features.note: Duration metadata exists for some records; version matching needs careful validation.

features.title: MusicBrainz recording and release identifiers
features.note: The MusicBrainz provider uses these identifiers for metadata and artwork lookup.

features.title: Music source attribution
features.note: Make provider/source attribution visible wherever required.

features.title: Recently played history
features.note: A recent-history shelf and API integration already exist.

features.title: Optional listening streaks
features.note: Keep opt-in and avoid guilt-based engagement mechanics.

features.title: New releases from followed artists
features.note: Depends on artist follows and a reliable release feed.

features.title: Playlist update notifications
features.note: Notify only users who opt in or follow the playlist.

features.title: Personal listening recap
features.note: Summarise actual recorded listening, with clear privacy controls.

features.title: Monthly listening report
features.note: Use only accurate, retained listening data.

features.title: Search and filter listening history
features.note: Respect incognito mode and account retention settings.

features.title: Clear or export listening history
features.note: Provide user-controlled deletion and export.

features.title: Notification preferences
features.note: Allow users to turn each notification type off.

features.title: Admin overview dashboard
features.note: A basic admin console is part of the current project.

features.title: Catalogue quality monitoring
features.note: Track missing and conflicting metadata.

features.title: Provider health monitoring
features.note: Report provider failures without exposing secrets.

features.title: YouTube API quota monitoring
features.note: Use server-side usage counts and Google quota information where available.

features.title: Artwork coverage reports
features.note: Measure how many releases have available artwork.

features.title: Duplicate metadata detection
features.note: Flag possible duplicates for review rather than auto-merging uncertain matches.

features.title: Broken external-link checks
features.note: Check links conservatively and respect provider policies.

features.title: User and artist moderation queues
features.note: The current project has artist applications and catalogue review workflows.

features.title: Recommendation quality metrics
features.note: Use aggregate, privacy-safe signals and transparent evaluation.

features.title: Audit logs and admin role controls
features.note: Role-based admin areas exist; verify every sensitive action and log coverage.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Seasonal music campaigns
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Marketing campaigns are not a core listening/discovery capability.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Search by lyrics
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Requires licensed/indexed lyric content; excluded from the current product scope.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Crossfade
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Not reliable across third-party embedded players such as YouTube/Apple embeds.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Playback speed
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Third-party embedded players do not give LOOP dependable speed control.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Collaborative playlists
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Adds sharing permissions, concurrency and moderation complexity; defer beyond core library.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Playlist folders
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Adds library complexity before the core playlist experience needs it.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Chart movement indicators
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Requires historical snapshots and a dependable chart provider; lower value than accurate charts.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Chart history snapshots
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Requires a persistent chart-data feed and retention policy.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Follow other listeners
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Turns LOOP toward a general social network rather than music discovery.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Friend activity feed
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Social feed is not required for the core music experience and creates privacy overhead.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Collaborative listening rooms
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Real-time presence/synchronisation is costly and not core to LOOP.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Playlist comments
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Moderation overhead outweighs value for the initial music-discovery product.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Track reactions
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Redundant with likes/saves and expands moderation needs.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Taste-match comparison with friends
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Requires social graph and profile exposure; not essential to music discovery.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Personalised home layout
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Adds layout complexity; personalising recommendations and banners is more useful.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Timed lyrics
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Requires a suitable licensed lyrics provider and usage rights.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Plain lyrics
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Requires a suitable licensed lyrics provider and usage rights.

removed_from_active_scope.title: Recommendation refresh notifications
removed_from_active_scope.reason: Low-value notification; daily/weekly mixes can be shown in the app without extra push.

notes: This roadmap is a curated product scope, not a completion claim.
Only mark features complete after relevant end-to-end tests pass.
Do not represent metadata-only tracks as playable audio.
Use official embedded playback and respect provider restrictions.
